question: On the map of India, the Malwa Plateau is located in which direction relative to the Chotanagpur Plateau?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**West**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Malwa Plateau** is located in the **central-western region of India** and is part of the larger Deccan Plateau.
 
• The **Chotanagpur Plateau**, on the other hand, lies in the **eastern region of India**, covering parts of **Jharkhand, Odisha, and West Bengal**.
 
• When comparing the relative locations of these two plateaus, the **Malwa Plateau lies to the west of the Chotanagpur Plateau.**
 
• The **Malwa Plateau** is primarily spread across the states of **Madhya Pradesh** and parts of **Rajasthan.**
 
• The Chotanagpur Plateau is rich in **mineral resources** such as coal, iron ore, and mica, while the Malwa Plateau is known for its **black soil**, which is suitable for growing crops like cotton and soybean.
 
• The location of these plateaus is significant for understanding the **geography, resource distribution, and agricultural practices** of India.
 
• To summarize, the **Malwa Plateau** lies **westward** when viewed relative to the position of the **Chotanagpur Plateau** on the map of India.
